notes: New report: Reports > Money flow (diagram). A Sankey picture of where the money went for any range: income sources (payroll, deposits, reimbursements) flow into Income, out to the spending groups, then on into the biggest categories in each group (the tail folds into 'Other ...'). Tick 'Include investments' for a second row under Income: market gains, dividends and money put in flow into Investments and out to Kept invested, fees and money taken back to the bank. When more was spent than earned, the gap shows as 'From investments' (cash actually pulled out of the investment accounts, matched transfers - never counted as income) and 'From savings' for the rest. Hover a band for the amount and share of income; click any block to open the report or transactions behind it. Prints on one page; phones pan sideways.
